title: Placement
note: How the item stands in the world once put down: whether it can be placed, how things stack on or in it, and the kit and blueprint flags.

placeable.label: Placeable
placeable.note: Whether the player can put this item on the ground. Every item with a model can be placed; set false to forbid it (lights and panels that mount on a building are never placed on the ground). Delivery still sets down as itself only the items that declare true; the rest arrive in boxes. The first left click brings out a shadow preview, R rotates it, Enter or a second click places it. Seeds that plant a growth group are never placed.

stacking_limit.label: Stack Limit (placed)
stacking_limit.note: How many identical PLACED ones can be stacked on each other in one grid square in the world (bags of cement: 4). 1 or empty = they do not stack. Needs placeable = true. A container sets this in its container block instead (container.stacking_limit), which wins when both are set. It is not the toolbar stack size (max_stack_size).

support_surface.label: Carries Things (pallet)
support_surface.note: A placed one carries items on top (a pallet): things placed over its deck rest on it, packed side by side and stacked up to their stacking limit. A pallet that still carries things cannot be picked up. Needs placeable = true.

deck_heights.label: Shelf Heights (shelving unit)
deck_heights.note: A support_surface item with several shelves (a shelving unit): the height of each shelf's top face above the ground, in metres, lowest first, comma separated ("0.15, 0.62, 1.09, 1.56"). Point at the open front of a shelf to put things on that one. Empty = one deck at the model's height (a pallet).

shelf.label: Shelf
shelf.note: A wall item (attach_surface wall) that is a SHELF: items are stood on its top face in a row (left click with the item in hand, right click the item to take it back). The top face is the top of the model bounds; see docs/ATTACHED_ITEMS.md.

pushable.label: Pushable
pushable.note: The player grabs it by the handles and pushes it along like a wheelbarrow (right click to grab, right click to put down) instead of picking it up. A portable generator is pushed.

is_blueprint.label: Blueprint
is_blueprint.note: Bought once, starts a build when held (structure site, path or road route) and is never used up. Shown on the blueprint blue (#35637C). Structures that build in stages are blueprints automatically.

builds_structure.label: Kit Builds Structure
builds_structure.note: A KIT: with it in hand a left click brings out the structure's preview (R turns it a quarter turn) and a second click starts its work site (the dirt area, the yard ring, the front arrow); the kit is used up. Structure id (a growth group of the structures category). The structure's own blueprint is then not for sale: the kit is how it is bought.
